title: Shutsudou! Miniskirt Police
native_title: 出動！ミニスカ・ポリス
overview:
Sometimes a kick! Sometimes a punch! Don't worry if your panties show!!

Based on the TV program of the same name, Shutsudou! Miniskirt Police collects photos of the actresses who appeared on the show as the blue-uniformed Miniskirt Police, along with a set of simple mini games such as a shooting game and a panel game. This first-run limited edition also came with a mini audio CD and a Miniskirt Police figure.

- Photo studio: browse the photo album
- Mini game collection
- Staff roll
